clips.title: The story
paras: In Tirisfal Glades, Gloom Weed grows in the fields between Deathknell and Brill. Gordo, a lumbering Forsaken abomination, gathers it by mistake while searching for doom weed.

Gloom Weed grows in the fields west of Brill and east of Solliden Farmstead. The plant is harmless, with none of the alchemical strength sought by the Royal Apothecary Society. Gordo, an abomination, wanders the road pulling weeds with his clumsy hands. He misunderstood his master's orders and keeps gathering Gloom Weed instead. Then he asks travelers to carry it to Master Holland in the Brill graveyard, much to the apothecary's annoyance.
